channel.title: The Klarity Blog
channel.description: Plain-language guides to Mac storage: what is filling your disk and how to get space back.

item.title: Apple Intelligence Storage on Mac: Why It Takes 20–30 GB
item.description: macOS 27 downloads Apple Intelligence by itself, often 20 to 30 GB, not Apple's 14. How to check yours, what you can't change, and what to clear instead.

item.title: Managing Storage on a 256GB MacBook, Day to Day
item.description: Is 256GB enough for a Mac? It can be, if you can see what is growing. A monthly habit that keeps a base-model Mac from filling up, without a panic purge.

item.title: Time Capsule Not Working on macOS 27? What to Use Instead
item.description: macOS 27 can't back up to a Time Capsule any more. What Apple says to use instead, how to set up a new Time Machine drive, and what to check first.

item.title: What's Taking Up Space on My External Drive on a Mac?
item.description: What's taking up space on your external drive? See all of it in one picture on your Mac, clear the big old folders safely, and get the space back.

item.title: How to Find Old Files on a Mac That Are Taking Up Space
item.description: Find the old files you forgot about on your Mac: what Finder can show, how to see what is both big and untouched for years, and how to clear it safely.

item.title: Klarity Disk Review: What Macworld Found, and What I Fixed
item.description: Macworld rated Klarity Disk 4 out of 5 and found a real bug. What the review got right, what Klarity 1.3 changed because of it, and what came next.

item.title: How Much Space Does macOS 27 Golden Gate Need to Install?
item.description: macOS 27 Golden Gate won't install without room to spare. How much free space it really needs, why sites quote different numbers, and how to find it fast.

item.title: Mac Storage Full After a macOS Update? Where the Space Went
item.description: Updated macOS and lost tens of gigabytes? The space is still there, in folders with names. Here is the fastest way to see which ones and clear them.

item.title: Klarity 1.3: Why Move to Trash Used to Fail, and What I Changed
item.description: Klarity 1.3 makes Move to Trash work everywhere. Why an App Store app cannot touch your files until you point at them, explained without jargon.

item.title: How to Clean Up Mac Storage: What's Safe to Delete in 2026
item.description: A step-by-step guide to freeing up space on a Mac, ordered from safest to riskiest: Trash, Downloads, caches, System Data, old apps, device backups, and what to leave alone.

item.title: How to Find Large Files on a Mac (Without Terminal)
item.description: Three ways to find the biggest files and folders on a Mac: Finder list view, a Finder search by size, and a treemap disk analyzer. Plus the seven folders where the space usually goes.

item.title: What Is “System Data” on a Mac, and What’s Safe to Clear?
item.description: System Data is macOS's catch-all storage category: caches, logs, Xcode data, snapshots and more. Here's what's actually inside it, how to look, and what you can safely delete.

item.title: Treemap vs Sunburst: Which Disk Map Finds Big Files Faster?
item.description: Sunburst charts look beautiful but hide small files. Here's why treemap and icicle views find space hogs faster on a Mac — with the perception research.

item.title: How I Built Glassmorphism on macOS 14 While Apple Requires macOS 26
item.description: Apple's Liquid Glass looks great, but .glassEffect() needs macOS 26. Here's how I built a complete glass design system for a shipping Mac app using only SwiftUI primitives available on macOS 14+.

item.title: Why I Built Klarity — A DaisyDisk Alternative for $6.99
item.description: I wanted a better way to see what's eating my Mac's storage. Existing tools didn't cut it. So I built Klarity — a $6.99 disk analyzer with treemap and icicle visualizations.
